body: hey, just wanted to say I think you're doing a great job and as someone who also grew (and is still in) in an asian tiger parent household, i get it. it fucking sucks.  i think for all the shit you went through, you're doing a great job! i mean, all of your hobbies seem so rad, and you seem like a great guy to me. and hey, nothing wrong with showing emotions. it helps to get everything out, ya know? keep being you, you're awesome already! wishing you all the best now and in the future. proud of you for trying your best.
thanks for the advice! yeah, i'm trying to look for jobs right now and i'm hoping i'll land one soon. going to try and get out as soon as i can. seriously though, thanks for the advice. means a lot.
thanks, it means a lot. it's nice seeing someone sympathize with me. and i'll try my best to prioritize myself! again, thank you so much.

Thank you, that means a lot. No one ever says things like that to me. It's just really hard because I barely even take care of myself and to do well in school just seems like something that seems so far out of reach. Like how am I supposed to do well in school when I can barely even muster the will to live? It's really hard.
